blocks.raw: <Tip>**Close contours = steep; wide contours = gentle.** Always read the contour interval and horizontal spacing to determine slope. Steep slopes require specialized grading (bench cuts, retaining walls, geotechnical analysis).</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Reversing contour logic: stating closely-spaced contours indicate flat terrain (wrong) instead of steep (correct)","Confusing slope percentage with slope ratio: a 1V:2H slope is 50% (not 2%)","Assuming cut and fill are 1:1 equivleant; they are not — soil compacts differently when placed as fill","Ignoring PD 1067 easements during grading design — fill and structures placed in easements violate water code","Calculating slope as rise/run without multiplying by 100; slope is a percentage, not a simple ratio"]} />
